description: Search and read approved business documents from Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Dropbox, with optional relevant-document recall before a turn.
skill_summary: How to search connected document libraries, open the authoritative file, preserve provider citations, and distinguish live documents from Memory and the native Wiki.
note: Uses each user's existing Google, Microsoft, or Dropbox OAuth connection. Configure approved folders or libraries here; OAuth application credentials remain in Productivity.

settings.label: Automatic Document Recall
settings.hint: Search configured libraries before substantive turns and inject a few cited excerpts.

settings.label: Maximum Search Results
settings.hint: Hard cap for document search results returned to the agent.

settings.label: Recall Excerpt Characters
settings.hint: Maximum characters injected from each automatically recalled document.
